name: Goldwin Inc
summary: Goldwin Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells apparel in Japan. The company offers jacket/vest, shell, down jacket/padded, fleece, rainwear, and coat; shirts/polo shirts, sweatshirts/trainers, t-shirt, cut and sew, sweaters and cardigans, tank tops/bra tops, long-sleeved tshirt, one piece, and camisole; long pants, skirt, tights/leggings, and short/half pants.It also provides swimwear, swimsuit, trunks, rash guard; underwear/tights; accessories, including socks, cap, knit cap/beanie, hat, swim cap, gloves, towel, pouch, goggles, sunglasses, bandana/handkerchief, hair band, belt, key ring, baby/kids items, head cover, wallets/pass cases, scarves/neck covers, and other products; bags; gears; shoes; and other products. The company offers its products under the Goldwin, Profecio, and per se, Canterbury, The North Face, Helly Hansen, Speedo, Macpac, Icebreaker, WOOLRICH, FISCHER, SUNSKI, Neutralworks, Allbirds, and PLAY EARTH KIDS brands. The company was formerly known as Tsuzawa Knit Fabric Manufacturer and changed its name to Goldwin Inc. in 1963. Goldwin Inc. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
